unknown: v2 covers the 30-session proof set PRISM scores only; compare it with v1 on the same sessions (same_sessions), not with the full year.
At 5 min, 2 trades were sized down and 2 not copied: no cash left, or too late in the day.
Exit assumed at 15:55 for 31 day trades he didn't say he closed.
Half the position assumed sold on 24 trims with no size.
22 entries with no share count took the upper median of his stated counts in that trade.
81 calls (levels he watched, no trade) are not copied.
12 exits had no matching entry and were skipped.
No look-ahead: a position stays open overnight only if he said so before 15:55 ET; a later add starts a new trade, sized from what he had said by then (contracts.md rule 13).
Prices are 1-minute market bars, not his own fills.
Costs are estimates: 5 bps per side, 20 under $10.
Just holding SPY leaves out its dividends (about 1% a year).
Worst drop counts closed trades only, not open ones.

as_taught.rules: contracts.md rules 6 and 11 as taught: a position carries overnight when his next word on it is an add, trim or close, and all of a trade's buys together are $1,000. Both read what he said later; the headline uses rule 13.
